scientific_limitations: Counts and sharp stability concern only nonzero fixed points on the invariant antidiagonal in the full real plane. Off-antidiagonal equilibria and global finite basins are not classified. The marginal spectrum is not assigned nonlinear stability. Unindexed equivalent formulas may affect originality.
